The Creation.posterAlt: Young plants grow along a rocky coast beside the sea in an imagined creation scene.
The Creation.description: Light spreads over dark water. Sky, land and plants appear, then the sun, moon and stars. Birds fly above the sea. Adam and Eve look around the garden before a final view of the quiet coast.

The Fall of Man.posterAlt: Eve reaches for fig-like fruit beside Adam and a serpent, with their bodies hidden by garden leaves.
The Fall of Man.description: Garden leaves conceal Adam and Eve beside a serpent and fig-like fruit. Close views show Eve eating, passing fruit to Adam, and Adam eating. Their eyes show concern. Later, wearing skin garments, they leave the garden.

Cain and Abel.posterAlt: One man carries grain while another holds a lamb beside a stone altar in an imagined scene.
Cain and Abel.description: Two men stand near a stone altar in a harvested field. One carries grain; the other holds a lamb. A curved tool lies among stalks. A man stands alone in wheat, then walks into dry land.

The Line of Seth.posterAlt: An older man, two younger adults and a child walk along a green hillside in an imagined scene.
The Line of Seth.description: An older man walks with two younger adults and a child through green fields. A lone figure crosses misty hills. Four men gather beside a stone house, where an elder rests his hand on a younger man.

Noah and the Flood.posterAlt: An older man stands before a wooden ark on dry ground, with a rainbow overhead in an imagined scene.
Noah and the Flood.description: An older man welcomes two adults into a wooden ark as animals gather outside. The ark floats on floodwater beneath dark clouds. Later, the man stands on dry ground beside the ark, and a rainbow appears overhead.

The Family of Noah.posterAlt: Two men carry a large cloth into a shaded tent. An imagined scene.
The Family of Noah.description: An older man gathers grapes with three younger men. Two men later carry a large cloth into a tent. The final scene shows groups walking toward settlements beside a river.

The Tower of Babel.posterAlt: People leave an unfinished brick wall and walk toward distant settlements. An imagined scene.
The Tower of Babel.description: Builders stand beside a tall mudbrick tower and struggle to understand each other. They leave the work behind and walk toward distant settlements.

The Call of Abram.posterAlt: An older traveler leads a household through rocky hills before dawn. An imagined scene.
The Call of Abram.description: A household travels through rocky hills before dawn. Later, an older man places stones together beneath trees.

Abram and Lot.posterAlt: Abram and Lot meet at night, with one resting a hand on the other's shoulder. An imagined scene.
Abram and Lot.description: An older man and a younger man look across a green valley. The younger man departs with his household and animals. Later, the two men meet again at night.

Hagar and Ishmael.posterAlt: A pregnant woman rests beside a spring in a rocky canyon. An imagined scene.
Hagar and Ishmael.description: A pregnant woman rests beside a spring in a shaded canyon. Later, she cradles a newborn outside a tent.

Abraham and Sarah’s Covenant.posterAlt: An older woman listens from her tent as a man serves three visitors. An imagined scene.
Abraham and Sarah’s Covenant.description: An older woman listens at a tent entrance. Behind her, a man serves food to three seated visitors. Her surprised expression becomes a smile.

Lot Leaves Sodom.posterAlt: An older man and two young women leave a burning city as another woman turns back. An imagined scene.
Lot Leaves Sodom.description: An older man and two young women climb a rocky path away from a burning city. Behind them, another woman pauses and turns back.

Isaac and Ishmael.posterAlt: A woman draws water beside a boy resting in the shade. An imagined scene.
Isaac and Ishmael.description: An older woman smiles with a young child. A woman and an older boy leave their camp. Later, the woman finds water and shares it with the boy.

The Binding of Isaac.posterAlt: An older man and a boy stand beside a stone altar and a ram. An imagined scene.
The Binding of Isaac.description: An older man and a boy carry supplies up a rocky path. They stand beside a stone altar. A ram appears in nearby thorn scrub.

Isaac and Rebekah.posterAlt: A traveler leads a line of camels away from a village at dusk. An imagined scene.
Isaac and Rebekah.description: A traveler leads camels from a village. A young woman gives water at a well. Later, she arrives with a camel and meets a man in a field.

Jacob and Esau.posterAlt: Two brothers share a bowl of stew beside a fire. An imagined scene.
Jacob and Esau.description: Two brothers exchange a bowl of stew. An older man blesses a younger man. A woman then gives the young man a bundle before he leaves.

Jacob’s Household.posterAlt: A father holds a child while his household works beside sheep. An imagined scene.
Jacob’s Household.description: A man meets a woman by a well. He later speaks with an older man and a woman. The final scene shows a growing household with children and sheep.

Jacob Returns to Canaan.posterAlt: Two brothers embrace beside a river as their households wait. An imagined scene.
Jacob Returns to Canaan.description: A caravan crosses open land. Two men struggle beside a river at night. Later, two brothers meet and embrace as their households wait nearby.

Dinah at Shechem.posterAlt: An older man talks with a seated man while two men stand nearby. An imagined scene.
Dinah at Shechem.description: Men meet in a courtyard. Two brothers stand together. A young woman leaves through a city gate, and an older man later addresses the brothers.

The Death of Rachel.posterAlt: A man mourns beside a standing stone as a woman holds a newborn. An imagined scene.
The Death of Rachel.description: A man rests his hand on a standing stone and bows his head. A woman holding a newborn and another man stand behind him at dusk.

Israel Oppressed in Egypt.posterAlt: Two workers shape mud bricks in the sun. An imagined scene.
Israel Oppressed in Egypt.description: A ruler speaks with men in a stone chamber. Workers shape mud bricks under the sun. Two women later speak together in a lamplit room.

Joseph and His Brothers.posterAlt: An older man holds a striped robe close to his face. An imagined scene.
Joseph and His Brothers.description: Joseph stands among sheep while his brothers watch. Bundles of grain fill a field. Later, he walks beside a man, and an older man holds a striped robe.

Joseph in Egypt.posterAlt: A man wearing an Egyptian collar watches workers carry baskets. An imagined scene.
Joseph in Egypt.description: Men speak inside a stone room. A young man then meets a ruler. Later, he wears an Egyptian collar and oversees people carrying baskets beside grain stores.

Judah and Tamar.posterAlt: A woman and an older man face each other across a table holding a staff and seal. An imagined scene.
Judah and Tamar.description: A woman waits at a doorway. A staff, cord and seal lie on a stone surface. Later, she presents these objects before an older man.

Moses Flees to Midian.posterAlt: A traveler shares a meal with an older man and a woman in a courtyard. An imagined scene.
Moses Flees to Midian.description: A man leaves a walled settlement and crosses dry ground. He meets women carrying water jars. Later, he shares food with an older man and a woman.

Moses Returns to Egypt.posterAlt: An older man holding a staff stands before elders who bow. An imagined scene.
Moses Returns to Egypt.description: An older man travels with a household and a donkey. He embraces another older man. Later, he addresses a group of elders, who bow.

Jacob Blesses His Family.posterAlt: An elderly Jacob wears a striped hood and looks down. An imagined scene.
Jacob Blesses His Family.description: A close portrait shows an elderly Jacob in a striped hood. He turns his gaze and lowers his head. His hands and sons are outside the frame.

Joseph Reunites His Family.posterAlt: Two men embrace in a stone hall. An imagined scene.
Joseph Reunites His Family.description: A man wearing an Egyptian collar places his hands on another man's shoulders. They embrace as other men watch nearby.

The Burning Bush.posterAlt: An older man holding a staff bows beside a burning bush. An imagined scene.
The Burning Bush.description: An older man stands beside a burning bush in rocky country. He lowers his head and bows while the branches remain visible within the flames.

Moses and Aaron Before Pharaoh.posterAlt: Moses and Aaron face a seated Pharaoh in an imagined Egyptian columned hall.
Moses and Aaron Before Pharaoh.description: Moses and Aaron appeal to Pharaoh in a columned hall. Pharaoh turns aside. Later, Moses watches workers press mud into brick molds.

The Plagues of Egypt.posterAlt: A farmer shields his face beneath a locust swarm beside canal farmland.
The Plagues of Egypt.description: A farmer shields his face as locusts sweep across fields beside an Egyptian canal. Dense darkness settles over a deserted mudbrick lane.

The Passover and the Death of the Firstb.posterAlt: A household shares flat bread around a low table in a lamplit room.
The Passover and the Death of the Firstb.description: A hand marks an ancient doorway beam. Inside, a household shares flatbread and food by lamplight, with the door closed and travel bundles ready.

The Exodus from Egypt.posterAlt: Moses walks with households and animals away from Egypt toward cloud.
The Exodus from Egypt.description: Moses leads households and animals away from Egypt toward a pillar of cloud. At night, the travelers move together across open wilderness toward a pillar of fire.

Crossing the Sea.posterAlt: Travelers cross dry ground between towering walls of water.
Crossing the Sea.description: Moses stands beside a path between walls of water. People and a loaded donkey cross on dry sand. Later, an elderly Miriam leads women with frame drums beside the sea.

Bitter Water, Manna and Quail.posterAlt: A family gathers white manna into woven baskets at dawn.
Bitter Water, Manna and Quail.description: Moses casts wood into bitter water. Quail settle beside a wilderness tent at evening. At dawn, a family gathers white manna into baskets.

Water from the Rock and the Battle with.posterAlt: Grey-haired Moses sits on a stone while Aaron in a striped mantle and another man support his outstretched arms from opposite sides.
Water from the Rock and the Battle with.description: Water flows from a rock as people fill jars. On a rocky hill, seated Moses holds his arms out while grey-haired Aaron and another man support his wrists and forearms from opposite sides.

Jethro Advises Moses.posterAlt: Jethro gestures with open hands while Moses listens beneath woven shade.
Jethro Advises Moses.description: Beneath a woven shade, Jethro gestures toward a waiting line while Moses listens. In the camp, elders hear visitors in smaller groups.

The Covenant and Ten Commandments at Sin.posterAlt: An assembly waits below a dark cloud-covered mountain lit by lightning.
The Covenant and Ten Commandments at Sin.description: The assembly waits below the boundary at a cloud-covered Sinai as lightning flashes over the summit. Moses approaches the thick cloud while the people remain behind.

The Covenant Is Sealed at Sinai.posterAlt: Moses and a companion walk up a rocky mountain path toward cloud.
The Covenant Is Sealed at Sinai.description: Hands hold an open covenant scroll before the assembly and stone altar. Later, Moses walks uphill toward cloud while a companion follows and pauses below.

The Birth and Rescue of Moses.posterAlt: An Egyptian woman opens a woven basket holding a wrapped infant among Nile reeds. An imagined scene.
The Birth and Rescue of Moses.description: A woman in linen kneels among reeds and opens a woven basket. A wrapped infant rests inside. An attendant leans closer as a girl watches nearby. Ripples move across the Nile.

The Golden Calf.posterAlt: Moses holds stone tablets as people gather around a golden calf in an imagined scene.
The Golden Calf.description: Moses stands before a golden calf while people celebrate behind him. He lowers the stone tablets and looks toward the gathering.

Moses Sees God's Glory.posterAlt: Moses shields his face in a rocky cleft as bright light passes outside. An imagined scene.
Moses Sees God's Glory.description: Moses shelters in a rocky cleft with his face shielded. Bright light passes outside, then fades as his cloak moves in the wind.

Building the Tabernacle.posterAlt: Craftspeople weave colored cloth and work on wooden frames beside the tabernacle. An imagined scene.
Building the Tabernacle.description: Craftspeople weave colored cloth and work on a wooden frame. The view moves toward the patterned curtains of the tabernacle.

Aaron and His Sons Are Ordained.posterAlt: Moses pours oil over Aaron's turban while two sons stand nearby. An imagined scene.
Aaron and His Sons Are Ordained.description: Moses pours oil over Aaron's head at the sanctuary entrance. Aaron bows his head as two sons stand nearby.

Nadab and Abihu.posterAlt: Two priests hold smoking incense pans near the sanctuary entrance. An imagined scene.
Nadab and Abihu.description: Two priests lift smoking incense pans at the sanctuary entrance. The view changes to fallen pans and glowing embers on the ground.

The Blasphemer Stoned.posterAlt: A man faces Moses and elders among the tents of the camp. An imagined scene.
The Blasphemer Stoned.description: A man stands before Moses and elders in the camp. Two men approach and guide him away while the others watch.

Counting the Camp.posterAlt: Hands arrange small stones into counted groups on a stone surface. An imagined scene.
Counting the Camp.description: Moses and Aaron stand beside camp elders who count small stones. Close views show hands sorting the stones into groups. The elders continue their work beside the tents.

Offerings and the Passover at Sinai.posterAlt: Three men carry offerings toward the tabernacle courtyard. An imagined scene.
Offerings and the Passover at Sinai.description: Three men walk toward a courtyard hung with blue and red cloth. One carries a metal bowl and another holds a woven basket. The entrance curtains move gently as they approach.

Leaving Sinai and the Complaints.posterAlt: Moses listens to elders beside resting families in a rocky camp. An imagined scene.
Leaving Sinai and the Complaints.description: Elders gather around Moses in a rocky camp. He listens with his staff in hand while families rest nearby. Small birds cross the cloudy sky as the camera moves closer.

Miriam and Aaron Speak Against Moses.posterAlt: A hooded woman faces Moses and Aaron outside a large tent. An imagined scene.
Miriam and Aaron Speak Against Moses.description: A woman seen from behind gestures toward Moses and Aaron outside a tent. Moses holds his staff and listens. Aaron turns toward him as the camera moves closer.

The Twelve Spies.posterAlt: Two scouts carry a heavy grape cluster on a wooden pole through a vineyard. An imagined scene.
The Twelve Spies.description: Two scouts carry a large cluster of grapes between them on a wooden pole. Other travelers walk ahead along the vineyard path. The fruit sways gently as the carriers move.

Water from the Rock at Meribah.posterAlt: People fill clay jars beneath water flowing from a rock beside Moses and Aaron. An imagined scene.
Water from the Rock at Meribah.description: Water flows from a rock into a shallow pool. People kneel to fill clay jars while Moses and Aaron watch. The camera moves closer to Moses holding his staff.

The Bronze Serpent.posterAlt: A bronze snake is fixed near the top of a wooden pole against a blue evening sky. An imagined scene.
The Bronze Serpent.description: Moses holds a tall pole beside people gathered at dusk. The camera moves upward to a bronze snake fixed near the top.

Korah's Rebellion.posterAlt: Elderly hands lift a wooden rod bearing almond blossoms and green fruit. An imagined scene.
Korah's Rebellion.description: Hands lift a wooden rod from a table. White flowers and green almonds grow along its branches. The hands turn the rod in the light.

Edom Refuses Passage and Aaron Dies.posterAlt: Elderly hands settle a blue robe with gold edging over a man's linen tunic. An imagined scene.
Edom Refuses Passage and Aaron Dies.description: Hands place a blue robe over a man's linen tunic. The cloth settles across his shoulders. Rocky hills rise behind him in the evening light.
